consensus_summary: SPLIT is used only as conservative package transport because none of the four non-DA Phase 2 cards supplies a per-seat editorial recommendation. Recommendation-level CONSENSUS-4 or CONSENSUS-3 therefore cannot be computed, and silence is not agreement. The DA is an adversarial seat and is excluded from the four-seat consensus basis. The R1 and R3 formal-interface remedies and the DA scalar-order remedy remain separate SINGLE-VERIFIER items; their architectural tension is preserved for author adjudication but is not classified as a consensus conflict. The P32-S13 status concern is corroborated by R1 and R2 at 2/4, below the consensus threshold.
dissenting_opinions: No recommendation-level dissent can be adjudicated because the four non-DA cards contain no per-seat editorial recommendations; SPLIT does not invent a substantive disagreement.

R1 and R3 request formal definitions and a consolidated interface, while DA requests an earlier conditional scalar comparison or an inadmissibility argument. These separately raised remedies remain visible as architectural tension, not as a consensus conflict, and the DA is not counted in the four-seat consensus basis.
